warning.titlePre: Range Rover TDV8 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your Range Rover TDV8 is a 2001-2021 model with the TDV8 or SDV8 diesel V8 - that's the L322 or L405 generation - timing chain and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, established across Land Rover specialist forums and independent garages. We replace worn timing chain components, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 and SDV8 rebuild.

include_in_hero_hook: yes - Source: extremely well-corroborated across Land Rover specialist forums and independent garages (per G-BRF). The TDV8 and SDV8 share the same known issue pattern as the TDV6/SDV6 sibling engine family.
